'''Rendili Vehicle Corporation''' was a vehicle-manufacturing corporation best known for manufacturing [[boulder-dozer]]s. They were associated with [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]], a [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-design and production company.

==History==
The company was in operation as far back as the [[Great Galactic War]] where it aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and possessed a facility at [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] which was involved in the fight against the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. They were involved with purchasing advanced prototype [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] from [[Barrga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] which had been developed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but they betrayed the Hutt by taking the drives and destroying the couriers who had delivered them. The corporation likely intended to examine them for the purpose of replicating them, allowing Rendili Vehicle Corporation to take advantage of the legal loopholes that protected other Republic corporations.
